Description: green rain jacket (over his head, not worn), carrying a black backpack; last seen walking near Canterbury Arcade.

Unable to find the POI; will keep an eye out in case he returns or offends elsewhere.
Arrived at HQ; taking lunch break and preparing for changeover.
Morning shift completed, no further issues.
